title: 資安基礎檢查 — Security Scan & Audit
content:
Run initial security scan across the entire platform: npm audit for dependency vulnerabilities, review for hardcoded secrets/keys, map auth boundaries, check CSP headers, rate limiting, S3 bucket permissions, SSL/TLS config. 

## Shannon AI Pentester — Test Plan

Tool: https://github.com/KeygraphHQ/shannon (Shannon is an autonomous AI pentester that analyzes source code + executes real exploits against running apps)

### CRITICAL WARNING — DO NOT POINT AT PRODUCTION
Shannon's exploitation agents actively mutate application state (create users, submit forms, trigger outbound requests, modify data). The README explicitly states: "Do not run Shannon against production systems." Running against lmc-portal production (Amplify) could corrupt real enrolments, payment records, and user data.

### Safe Testing Approach (Recommended)
1. **Set up a local staging mirror first** — spin up a local instance (`npm run dev`) with a separate local DB (`npm run db:start` + `npm run db:migrate`). Seed with disposable test data.
2. **Ensure Docker is running** — Shannon requires Docker for its worker container.
3. **Get AI provider credentials** — Shannon supports Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI, AWS Bedrock, or any Pi-harness provider via BYOK. Claude Opus 5 or DeepSeek v4 Flash recommended.
4. **Clear cyber safeguards** — If using Anthropic/OpenAI, complete their legitimate-security-tester clearance process first (otherwise they interrupt scans mid-run).
5. **Run against local instance**:
   ```
   npx @keygraph/shannon@latest setup
   npx @keygraph/shannon@latest start -u http://localhost:3000 -r /path/to/lmc-portal
   ```
6. **Review results locally** — Shannon outputs PDF + Markdown + SARIF reports. Findings still require human review (LLM reports can contain false positives).

### Alternative: GitHub Action (Staging Only)
If you have a staging deployment, use the Shannon GitHub Action at https://github.com/KeygraphHQ/shannon-action. Never wire it to production.

### What Shannon Can Test
- OWASP Top 10: Injection, XSS, SSRF, broken auth, broken authorization
- Authenticated testing with credentials/login flows/TOTP
- Source code analysis + live exploitation
- "No exploit, no report" — only confirmed vulnerabilities with PoC

### Limitations
- Full run takes ~1-1.5 hours, incurs LLM API costs
- Not a replacement for human pentesters (expert chaining + business logic understanding)
- Models that don't follow instructions reliably produce weaker results
- Requires Docker + Node 18+
- Do not scan untrusted/adversarial codebases (prompt injection risk)
